services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: Each trip is tailored for your group, combining education, entertainment, and scenic views across the region’s waterways. From narrated eco-adventures through tidal creeks and salt marshes to historic cruises along the Savannah River and Harbor, every journey offers a deeper look at the coastal environment and its heritage. Along the way, you may encounter dolphins, egrets along oyster beds, working ships at the Port of Savannah, and the diverse birdlife of the Savannah Refuge.
